notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
At least one additional +1/+1 counter on any creature.
description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}.
Activate Ghave's first activated ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from any creature, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's last ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Saproling token.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creatures you control.
Resolve the Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Repeat.
